medicaid_sdud.gap: 2000-2011 not bulk-extracted (separate per-year datasets on data.medicaid.gov; full JSON extraction impractical). Subset of 8 states processed; only prescription_count metric retained.

nhs_prescribing.gap: 2010-2022 available but not extracted in this run; NHSBSA API reachable.

cms_part_d.gap: None within dataset availability (2020-2022). Dataset contains later years beyond range not included.

dea_arcos.gap: PDFs downloaded for 2016-2022; structured parsing not performed. 2006-2015 not found at the summary URL.

fda_recalls.gap: None within openFDA coverage (2004 onward). 2000-2003 not covered by source.

gaps_2000_2003: No free official drug-level utilization source in this pipeline covers 2000-2003; combined files for those years are empty arrays.
notes: Years with no observations have an empty JSON array in data/combined/.
Missingness is explicit: null = unavailable, 0 = source reported zero.
No synthetic or interpolated values were created.
Do not sum national records with state records; do not combine units across sources.
